comparison.objective: Measure and place a block 10 cm beyond a reference line; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Ruler use, spatial measurement, and placement versus precision tool engagement and iterative mechanical adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Block center must be within 1 cm for full credit and rest on the table; candidate uses stroke, impact, rebound, overload, and drift criteria.
comparison.reason: Measurement-guided placement and dynamic commissioning are unrelated tested abilities.
